note: One line of use for items whose use the other data files do not show (no recipe uses them yet, or they are used by the world, not a recipe). tools/item_master_list.py reads it; every live item must have a use line or a recipe that uses it. Add a line when you add such an item.

uses.campfire_kit: Placed on the ground as a laid fire; light it with tinder, feed it wood. Cooks, warms, lights.
uses.seed_bundle: Eaten raw, or planted in a farm patch (seeds).
uses.tree_roots: Fuel and fibre source; chopped to roots, later twine and baskets.
uses.driftwood: Dry fuel for a fire; burns fast. Also a stick for tools.
uses.soil: Dug earth: fills holes, makes raised patches and mounds.
uses.gravel: Dug gravel: paths, fills, and the base of a cobble floor.
uses.rotten_food: Spoiled food: worthless, drops to the ground or feeds a compost heap later.
uses.cut_stone_block: Masonry: stone wall and floor tiers (blueprints), with mortar.
uses.brick: Brick walls, chimneys, the clay hearth and the oven (blueprints).
uses.mortar: Binds stone blocks and bricks in masonry blueprints.
uses.rough_plank: Rough building boards; fine board and shingles come from them at a sawmill.
uses.fine_board: Furniture and fine floors at a woodworking table.
uses.tar: Seals a flat roof and soaks logs against rot.
uses.wooden_pin: Joins logs and beams without iron (timber frame blueprints).
uses.firewood_soft: Fast, short fuel for a fire (pine, spruce, fir).
uses.wooden_block_soft: Split on a chopping block into soft firewood.
uses.feather: Fletching for arrows (bow and arrow build); a trophy and a quill later.
uses.lumber_oak: Building boards of this wood: timber blueprints and furniture (the wood's own colour and grain).
uses.beam_oak: Frame beams of this wood: timber set, floors and roofs (blueprints).
